Pick a path

Same Jesus—friendly doors. Loops for a quick replay, full stories when you have a few minutes, coloring when little hands want to make something, and calm prayer habits when you want screen-light time with God.

Need the family map? For the Little Ones is the calm all-in-one first stop, Family hub is the parent doorway, Bible Story Library is for read-aloud cards, Bible Loop Library is for quick replays, and Color & Tell is for hands-busy retelling.

For very young kids, Color & Tell and one comfort loop are the gentlest first doors. Save the longer story cards for when they want a few more minutes.

Best for ages 5-8 🎬 Quick Bible loops Short, bouncy cartoons—replay-safe when little hearts need calm. Best for ages 7-11 📚 Full Bible stories Read-along words, comic panels, and gentle quizzes live in the Library. Some stories add a short YouTube preview. Best for ages 5-10 🖍️ Color & create Tap a big picture, paint on the page, print for the fridge—KJV line on each sheet. Best for any age with a grown-up 🙏 Calm prayer habits Five-finger prayer, thank-you slips, paper chains—screen-light, ties to today’s verse. Printable sheet inside.

First Win Path

If you are brand new, start here: one story, one response, one small finish. Zechariah 4:10 reminds us not to despise the day of small things.

1. Open David & Goliath Read one brave story and earn your Little Explorer start. 2. Color one scene Little hands can answer the verse without needing more talking.

Start with one story and your first gentle badge will land here.

For private Christian schools & church teams

Built to be fun for kids and usable for leaders: KJV-only memory, short rhythms, and print-friendly handoff tools.

  • 2 minutes: start with one quick loop for attention and joy.
  • 8 minutes: open one Bible Story Library card and use the read-and-quiz flow.
  • 5 minutes: finish with one prayer habit or coloring response and a memory-verse repeat.

Weekly kids paths

Use the stories already here, then carry them through the week with one short plan or one printable. Nothing needs a new account.

7 days The Lord’s Prayer for Kids Simple phrases, pray-together language, and calm family repetition. 9 days Beatitudes for Kids Quiet heart training with simple words and no pressure-heavy tone. 7 days Parable of the Sower for Kids One honest question, one tiny action, one story thread you can revisit. 8 weeks Summer Seeds One anchor day per week when your family wants the lightest possible rhythm.
